mapper.sql: ( r.resource_type = 'file' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_file_info_table f WHERE f.file_id = r.file_id AND f.file_author_id = s.share_owner_id AND (f.file_space_id = r.space_id OR (f.file_space_id IS NULL AND r.space_id IS NULL)) AND f.file_status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND c.user_id = f.file_author_id AND (c.closure_space_id = f.file_space_id OR (c.closure_space_id IS NULL AND f.file_space_id IS NULL)) AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) ) OR ( r.resource_type = 'folder' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_tree_table d WHERE d.node_id = r.node_id AND d.node_user_id = s.share_owner_id AND (d.node_space_id = r.space_id OR (d.node_space_id IS NULL AND r.space_id IS NULL)) AND d.node_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table ancestor_node ON ancestor_node.node_id = c.ancestor_id WHERE c.descendant_id = d.node_id AND c.user_id = d.node_user_id AND (c.closure_space_id = d.node_space_id OR (c.closure_space_id IS NULL AND d.node_space_id IS NULL)) AND ancestor_node.node_status IN ('trashed', 'deleted') ) ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_share_link_table ( share_id, share_token, share_owner_id, share_space_id, share_name, share_description, share_password, share_has_password, share_allow_download, share_expires_at, share_status ) VALUES ( #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_token}, #{share_owner_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{share_name}, #{share_description}, #{share_password}, #{share_has_password}, #{share_allow_download}, #{share_expires_at}, 'active' )
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.user_name AS owner_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = s.share_id AND () ) AS resource_count FROM pcd_share_link_table s LEFT JOIN pcd_user_info_table u ON s.share_owner_id = u.user_id WHERE s.share_id = #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND (#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL OR s.share_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND s.share_space_id IS NULL))

SELECT s.share_id, s.share_token, s.share_owner_id, s.share_space_id, s.share_name, s.share_description, s.share_password, s.share_has_password, s.share_allow_download, s.share_expires_at, s.share_view_count, s.share_status, s.share_created_at, s.share_updated_at, u.user_name AS owner_name, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = s.share_id AND () ) AS resource_count FROM pcd_share_link_table s LEFT JOIN pcd_user_info_table u ON s.share_owner_id = u.user_id WHERE s.share_token = #{share_token} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = s.share_id AND () )

SELECT s.share_id, s.share_token, s.share_owner_id, s.share_space_id, s.share_name, s.share_description, s.share_password, s.share_has_password, s.share_allow_download, s.share_expires_at, s.share_view_count, s.share_status, s.share_created_at, s.share_updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = s.share_id AND () ) AS resource_count FROM pcd_share_link_table s WHERE s.share_owner_id = #{owner_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND (s.share_space_id=#{currentSpaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{personalSpace}=true AND s.share_space_id IS NULL)) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = s.share_id AND () ) ORDER BY s.share_created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pcd_share_link_table SET share_status = 'expired' WHERE share_status = 'active' AND share_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND share_expires_at < NOW()
